title: C-Plane Weekly Bridge Brief — Mar 18 2027
content:
(meeting notes)
Date: 2027-03-18
Attendees: Aisha, Jordan, Mateo, Rheya, Ben (SRE), Priya (Platform QoS)
Goal: short sync to align on cross-cutting routing/auth/quotas work and surface any fallthroughs before sprint planning.

High level:
- Quick status: routing fallthrough rate increased from 0.9% -> 1.05% last 24h; spike concentrated in eu-west-1 and related to weight-based routing fallback logic.
- Quota enforcement latencies: p95 enforcement latency rose to 78ms (baseline ~45ms) after last week's inline telemetry change.
- Auth cache evictions: new edge-cache TTLs caused a thundering update in a small tenant group (~300 users).

Decisions:
- Rollback the telemetry change in quotas (INF-3421) to gate impact while we iterate on batching and lock contention analysis. Target: rollback by EOD 2027-03-18.
- Start a 48h canary of a variant of routing fallback that short-circuits to regional standby pools for high-variance customers (prototype branch in PR 889).
- Move the problematic tenant group to a pilot TTL override (config flag) and add rate-limited cache warmup.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Jordan: submit rollback CL for quota telemetry change and coordinate with deploy ops. ETA: 2027-03-18 17:00 UTC.
- Mateo: run perf profile on quota enforcement path, produce hot-call graph and a short list of candidate mitigations (lock sharding, batching). ETA: 2027-03-19.
- Rheya: add more granular routing logs for eu-west-1, include candidate keys to identify weight calc anomalies. ETA: 2027-03-19 morning.
- Ben (SRE): prepare deployment window for routing canary and post-mort checklist in case latency regresses. ETA: 2027-03-20.
- Priya: draft small-run experiment for cache warmup throttling and coordinate with tenant owners. ETA: 2027-03-21.

Risks / Blockers:
- If rollback is delayed beyond 24h, we risk SLA blips for paid dedicated slots (noted uptick in trace errors for two customers).
- Routing canary may increase tail latency if regional standby pools are cold; need to ensure KV cache priming before traffic ramp.

Notes to self / triage fragments:
- Suspect lock contention in QuotaEnforcer.enforce() around accounting map; check for repeated allocations on every request.
- Quick spike repro: replay traffic from 2027-03-16 03:00-04:30 UTC in staging against latest quota build; use the 'heavy-wt-routing' seed.
- Consider experiment: adaptive quota gating (start with soft-deny after threshold then hard deny) — see Confluence sketch for policy states.

Sticky quick wins (low-effort):
- Add an additional 10ms sleep jitter to auth cache refresh to avoid synchronized evictions (small probability win).
- Backfill routing weight calc with last-known-good weights if computation times out (>200ms) to reduce fallthroughs.

Follow-ups / meeting asks:
- Need platform metrics dashboard tile showing "quota enforcement p95" with annotation for deploys.
- Requesting 2h paired debugging slot with runtime eng next Wed to iterate on kernel-level latency hotspots.

Appendix / references:
- Repro steps for staging replay and links: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbook/replay
- INF-3421 ticket: high-level notes and incident timeline.
- PR 889: prototype for regional-standby fallback (benchmarks included in PR description).

End notes: keep this doc as working scratch for handoff to next shift. Will convert to a cleaner postmortem if rollback doesn't fix the metric within 48h.
